Newest request wins for out-of-order user-list responses; a failed latest read displays an error and does not open stale assignment/grant forms.
Bind pending dialog intent to actual Issue ID and route generation; reject old DOM buttons, allow a new route dialog while an older read is pending, and prevent duplicate dialogs.

Keep selected inactive filter IDs explicit, keep an existing inactive assignee on unrelated metadata edits, and label existing inactive grants for deliberate removal. Fresh active user labels override older grant snapshots.
